You are a senior Python engineer on a hackathon team (demo Sunday 14:00). Work directly in the repo; do NOT commit or push. Others edit the frontend in parallel: you may ONLY edit src/ask_soony/api.py (only the functions named below), src/ask_soony/voice.py, src/ask_soony/cardtools.py, web/src/components/VoiceCall.tsx, tests/ (new test files or tests/test_alert_agent.py), and create scripts/demo_cards.py. Do not edit routines.py, other web files, or data/state by hand except via your script. Repo: /Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/StartMunichHack/ask-soony. Run tests with `uv run pytest -q` (all must pass; tests run in an empty cwd via tests/conftest.py autouse fixture), lint with `uv run ruff check src tests --exclude tests/test_platform.py` (line length 100). Python docstrings: multi-line ones start with """ alone on the first line. No em dashes in text.

Tasks:
1. Activity `via`. In api.py, `build_activity()` builds the activity list from cards/statuses; actions.json (a list) records each decision with an optional `via` ("inbox", "voice", "routine: <name>"; see approve() which writes body.get("via")). Make each decided card's activity item carry `via` from its latest action (look up by decision_id; card['ui'] has action_id from decision_status.json). Also make escalate/dismiss accept and record `via` from the body like approve does. Keep the change minimal (api.py is a teammate's file; only touch build_activity, escalate, dismiss and what they need). cardtools.run_tool already calls api.approve with via "voice"; pass via "voice" for escalate/dismiss too.
2. Voice → routine. In the voice assistant (voice.py instructions + cardtools TOOLS/run_tool), add a tool `teach_routine(instruction: str)` for when the buyer says something like "next time just do that automatically". It must NOT create or enable a routine: it calls routines.suggest(card_id) (only valid after the card was decided; if it is still open, return {ok: false, error: "decide first"}), stores the draft for the UI and returns {ok, name, description} so the assistant can say: "I've drafted it as a routine. Check it on screen before it starts." Store drafts in state file routine_drafts.json via api.read_json/write_json keyed by card id, and expose GET /api/routines/drafts (add the route in cardtools.router, not routines.py) so the UI can pick it up; also send a push via push.send("Routine draft ready", name, card_id) wrapped in try/except. Update the voice instructions accordingly (plain buyer language; voice never turns a routine on). In VoiceCall.tsx, when the tool returns ok, add a transcript system line "Routine drafted: <name> · review it under Routines".
3. Demo cards from real data: create scripts/demo_cards.py that writes demo findings/decisions/impacts into data/state (findings.json, decisions.json, impacts.json lists; merge by id, keep other entries; idempotent; `--reset` also clears decision_status.json, actions.json, replies_seen.json, teams_posted.json and disables all routines in routines.json, after backing each file up as <name>.before-demo-<timestamp>.json). Format: see the existing example entry `paper-4500318735-CMP-GAM-001` currently in data/state/findings.json, decisions.json, impacts.json (read them) and how api.build_cards consumes findings/decisions/impacts (sides with source/value/doc/page/quote/translation/language, decision options with action/cost/effect/channel/to/draft/recommended, level, headline, reason, deadline, trail). The script must read the SAP/ERP values it states from the portal CSVs at runtime (portal root via ask_soony.api.portal_root()) and keep document references (path, page, verbatim quote) as data in the script; if a referenced file is missing, skip that card with a warning. Cases (verified by our data scout; re-check each file/value before using it):
   a) KEEP the existing Hwaseong card (paper-4500318735-CMP-GAM-001) exactly.
   b) Art books: goods_receipts.csv GR 5000413065 (PO 4500318768 line 3, ordered 8000) booked qty_received 80000 "over delivery accepted"; scan soony/receiving/DC-HAM/20261118_WZ-261116-473.jpg shows printed 80.000 struck through and handwritten 8 000 (40 packages, 360 kg). Headline: "We have 19,300 art books, not 91,300. The Collector's cell runs out about 5,900 copies early." Options: recommended "Order Karton Nowak's 8,000 art books from stock (truck tonight)" cost "about EUR 16,800" channel email to the Karton Nowak address from its profile (suppliers/SUP-0028_Karton_Nowak/profile.csv) with a short polite draft referencing their express offer suppliers/SUP-0028_Karton_Nowak/notices/Oferta_tryb_ekspresowy_2026-11-21.pdf; second option "Ask receiving to correct the goods receipt to 8,000" channel notify to "DC receiving", cost "No cost". Level red.
   c) Cover sleeves revision: ECN rev B→C (soony/master/bom_delta_2026-11-21.csv, "parts to rev B must not be packed"); PackRight order confirmations confirm "Artwork PR-SL-0604: rev. B". Create ONE card per affected open PackRight sleeve PO among 4500318752, 4500318765, 4500318774, 4500318786 (verify each OA PDF says rev. B; find the files under suppliers/SUP-0029_Guangzhou_PackRight/order_confirmations/), headline "PackRight confirmed PO <po> with the old sleeve artwork (rev B)", level amber, one recommended option "Ask PackRight to print PO <po> to artwork rev C" channel email to the PackRight address from its profile, cost "No cost", draft short and specific (PO, part PR-SL-0604/CMP-GAM-004, rev C file name from the ECN or Karton Nowak's confirmations), plus a second option "Tell the category lead" channel notify cost "No cost". These are the SAME KIND so a routine learned from the first can handle the others (that is the demo). Sides: system says (PO row from purchase_orders csv: qty, promised date, status) vs document says (OA PDF path, page 1, quote "Artwork PR-SL-0604: rev. B (GH6_sleeve_revB.pdf)").
   d) Statues failed inspection: goods_receipts GR 5000413063 (PO 4500318727, 5,600 unrestricted) vs soony/receiving/DC-HAM/inspection_report_5000413063.pdf page 1 ("Lot does not meet AQL…"). Headline "5,600 statues on the shelf failed inspection. Without them we are 3,400 Collector's copies short." Options: recommended "Ask Supplier Quality and the category lead for a concession or a 100% sort today" channel notify cost "No cost"; level red.
   Every card: trail with 2-3 agent steps (Watcher found the file, Verification matched SAP row X, …), created_at now, deadline sensible (e.g. Sun 10:00 / 12:00 local; check ASK_NOW/tz handling in api.now()). Verify after running the script that /api/state shows the cards (open, in inbox_ids) with evidence, and that `from ask_soony import anchors; anchors.build_index(); anchors.find(...)` anchors each document side (adjust quotes so the numbers/ids appear in the document). Run `uv run python scripts/demo_cards.py` once for real at the end (it must NOT send any email; never call approve). The live server reads data/state on every request, no restart needed.
4. Tests: add tests for build_activity `via`, teach_routine refusing an open card and storing a draft (monkeypatch routines.suggest), and demo_cards writing idempotently into a temp ASK_STATE_DIR with a fake portal (keep it small).
Final report: files changed, how to run the demo reset, what each card shows, test results.

"""
What the alert agent does with an inbox card, for the voice assistant and the Approve button alike.

- deliver(): the one send path. If the approved option is an email to an address listed in the
  portal's supplier profiles, send it from the agent mailbox and return the message id. Anything
  else (internal roles, no draft) is only recorded, never sent.
- POST /api/cards/{id}/tool: the voice assistant's tools. They call the inbox's own approve /
  escalate / dismiss, so a spoken "yes" and a click behave the same and land in the same
  actions.json and decision_status.json.
"""

import os
import re
import smtplib
import ssl
from email.message import EmailMessage
from email.utils import formatdate, make_msgid

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

from ask_soony.config import load_dotenv

router = APIRouter()

TOOLS = [
    {
        "type": "function",
        "name": "get_card_details",
        "description": "Look up this card's options (with recipient and draft), evidence and "
        "status. Use it before answering questions about sources, costs or what would be sent.",
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {}},
    },
    {
        "type": "function",
        "name": "decide",
        "description": "Record the person's decision on this card. approve carries out the chosen "
        "option: if it is an email to a supplier, it is sent. Only approve after reading out what "
        "will happen (recipient and gist for an email) and the person clearly said yes.",
        "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "decision": {"type": "string", "enum": ["approve", "escalate", "reject"]},
                "option_index": {"type": "integer", "description": "Which option, 0 = recommended"},
                "note": {"type": "string", "description": "Short reason or condition, if any"},
                "confirmed": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "description": "True only if the person explicitly confirmed",
                },
            },
            "required": ["decision", "confirmed"],
        },
    },
]


def supplier_addresses() -> set[str]:
    """Every email address in the portal's supplier profiles (CSV or JSON, any layout)."""
    from ask_soony import api

    root = api.portal_root()
    found: set[str] = set()
    if root is None:
        return found
    for path in (root / "suppliers").glob("*/profile.*"):
        try:
            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        except OSError:
            continue
        found |= {m.lower() for m in re.findall(r"[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+(?:\.[\w-]+)+", text)}
    return found


def _send_mail(to: str, subject: str, body: str) -> str:
    load_dotenv()
    user = os.environ.get("ASK_MAIL_ADDRESS", "")
    password = os.environ.get("ASK_MAIL_PASSWORD", "").replace(" ", "")
    host = os.environ.get("ASK_SMTP_HOST", "")
    if not (user and password and host):
        raise HTTPException(503, "mail account not configured")
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"], msg["To"], msg["Subject"] = user, to, subject
    msg["Date"] = formatdate(localtime=True)
    msg["Message-ID"] = mid = make_msgid(domain=user.split("@")[-1])
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(host, 587, timeout=30) as s:
        s.starttls(context=ssl.create_default_context())
        s.login(user, password)
        s.send_message(msg)
    return mid


def deliver(card: dict, option: dict, text: str | None) -> dict | None:
    """Send the approved option if it is an email to a known supplier; None if nothing was sent."""
    to = (option.get("to") or "").strip().lower()
    body = (text or option.get("draft") or "").strip()
    if option.get("channel") != "email" or not body or to not in supplier_addresses():
        return None
    subject = option.get("subject") or card.get("headline") or "Soony procurement"
    mid = _send_mail(to, subject, body)
    return {"message_id": mid, "to": to, "subject": subject, "sent_body": body}


class ToolCall(BaseModel):
    name: str
    arguments: dict = {}


def _details(card: dict) -> dict:
    ui = card.get("ui") or {}
    return {
        "headline": card.get("headline"),
        "summary": card.get("summary"),
        "status": card.get("status"),
        "approver": card.get("approver"),
        "options": [
            {
                "index": o.get("index", i),
                "action": o.get("action"),
                "cost": o.get("cost"),
                "effect": o.get("effect"),
                "channel": o.get("channel"),
                "to": o.get("to"),
                "draft": (o.get("draft") or "")[:600],
            }
            for i, o in enumerate(card.get("options") or [])
        ],
        "evidence": (card.get("evidence") or [])[:8],
        "supplier_reply": ui.get("reply"),
    }


@router.post("/api/cards/{card_id}/tool")
def run_tool(card_id: str, call: ToolCall):
    from ask_soony import api

    card = api._card(card_id)
    args = call.arguments or {}
    if call.name == "get_card_details":
        return _details(card)
    if call.name != "decide":
        raise HTTPException(400, f"unknown tool {call.name}")

    decision = str(args.get("decision") or "")
    note = str(args.get("note") or "").strip()[:300]
    if card.get("status") not in ("open", None):
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"Already {card.get('status')}; nothing changed."}
    if decision == "approve":
        if not args.get("confirmed"):
            return {"ok": False, "error": "Not done: ask the person to confirm first."}
        idx = int(args.get("option_index") or 0)
        if not 0 <= idx < len(card.get("options") or []):
            return {"ok": False, "error": f"No option {idx}."}
        out = api.approve(card_id, {"option": idx, "via": "voice"})
        action = out["action"]
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "status": action.get("status"),
            "sent_to": action.get("to") if action.get("status") == "sent" else None,
            "offer_trust": out.get("offer_trust"),
        }
    if decision == "escalate":
        action = api.escalate(card_id, {"note": note or "escalated by voice"})
        try:
            from ask_soony import push

            push.send("⬆️ Escalated launch alert", f"{card.get('headline', '')}", card_id)
        except Exception:  # no devices: the escalation is recorded anyway
            pass
        return {"ok": True, "status": "escalated", "to": action.get("to")}
    if decision == "reject":
        api.dismiss(card_id, {"note": note or "rejected by voice"})
        return {"ok": True, "status": "dismissed"}
    return {"ok": False, "error": f"unknown decision {decision}"}
"""
Voice conversation about a decision card, in the browser (OpenAI gpt-realtime over WebRTC).

The browser asks this route for a short-lived OpenAI client secret; the API key never leaves the
server. The secret carries the session: the card as instructions, a voice, noise handling and the
card tools (cardtools.TOOLS). The browser talks to OpenAI directly and relays tool calls to
/api/cards/{id}/tool, which decides through the inbox's own approve / escalate / dismiss.
"""

import json
import os

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException

from ask_soony import cardtools
from ask_soony.config import load_dotenv

router = APIRouter()


def _text(value) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return "; ".join(f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in value.items() if v not in (None, "", []))
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)


def instructions(card: dict) -> str:
    options = (
        "\n".join(
            f"- option {o.get('index', i)}: {o.get('action')}"
            + (f" (cost: {o['cost']})" if o.get("cost") else "")
            + (f" (effect: {o['effect']})" if o.get("effect") else "")
            + (
                f" [sends an email to {o['to']}]"
                if o.get("channel") == "email" and o.get("to")
                else ""
            )
            for i, o in enumerate(card.get("options") or [])
        )
        or "- none listed"
    )
    evidence = "\n".join(
        f"- {e.get('source') or ''}: "
        + str(e.get("value") or e.get("translation") or e.get("quote") or "")
        for e in (card.get("evidence") or [])[:6]
    )
    facts = [
        f"Headline: {card.get('headline', '')}",
        f"Summary: {card.get('summary') or ''}",
        f"Supplier: {card.get('supplier_name') or 'n/a'}, part: {card.get('part') or 'n/a'}",
        f"{card.get('number_label') or 'At risk'}: {card.get('number')}",
        f"Decide by: {card.get('deadline') or 'not given'}",
        f"Runs dry: {card.get('runs_dry') or 'n/a'}",
        f"Status: {card.get('status')}; approver: {card.get('approver') or 'the buyer'}",
        f"Evidence:\n{evidence or '- none'}",
        f"Options:\n{options}",
        f"Supplier reply so far: {(card.get('ui') or {}).get('reply') or 'none yet'}",
    ]
    return (
        "You are the procurement assistant of the dashboard, talking to a buyer about one decision "
        "card that threatens the product launch. Speak English, calmly and briefly.\n\n"
        + "\n".join(facts)
        + "\n\nStart by stating the problem in two short sentences and the recommended option. "
        "Answer questions only with the facts above; if you do not know, say so. Then ask for a "
        "decision: approve the recommended action, escalate to the next person, or reject. "
        "Tools: use get_card_details when asked about sources, costs or what would be sent. "
        "Before approving, say what will happen; for an option that sends an email, read out the "
        "recipient and gist and ask 'Shall I send it now?'. Only after a clear yes call decide "
        "with decision approve, the option index and confirmed true, then confirm in one "
        "sentence (say it was sent if sent_to is set) and say goodbye. For escalate or reject, "
        "call decide the same way.\n\n"
        "The person may be in a noisy room. Only respond to what they say to you about this card. "
        "Ignore background conversations, other languages and fragments; if unsure, ask: 'Sorry, "
        "was that for me?' Never record a decision from background speech."
    )


@router.post("/api/cards/{card_id}/voice")
def voice_session(card_id: str):
    load_dotenv()
    key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    if not key:
        raise HTTPException(503, "OPENAI_API_KEY is not set")
    from ask_soony import api  # late import: api includes this router

    card = api._card(card_id)
    model = os.environ.get("OPENAI_REALTIME_MODEL", "gpt-realtime-2.1")
    session = {
        "type": "realtime",
        "model": model,
        "instructions": instructions(card),
        "audio": {
            "output": {"voice": os.environ.get("OPENAI_REALTIME_VOICE", "marin")},
            "input": {
                "noise_reduction": {"type": "near_field"},
                "transcription": {
                    "model": "gpt-4o-mini-transcribe",
                    "language": "en",
                    "prompt": "A buyer talking about a supply chain decision card.",
                },
                "turn_detection": {
                    "type": "server_vad",
                    "threshold": float(os.environ.get("OPENAI_VAD_THRESHOLD", "0.8")),
                    "prefix_padding_ms": 300,
                    "silence_duration_ms": 700,
                    "create_response": True,
                    "interrupt_response": False,
                },
            },
        },
        "tools": cardtools.TOOLS,
        "tool_choice": "auto",
    }
    resp = httpx.post(
        "https://api.openai.com/v1/realtime/client_secrets",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"},
        json={"expires_after": {"anchor": "created_at", "seconds": 600}, "session": session},
        timeout=20,
    )
    if resp.status_code >= 300:
        raise HTTPException(502, f"OpenAI refused the session: {resp.text[:300]}")
    return {"client_secret": resp.json().get("value"), "model": model}

"""
What the alert agent does with an inbox card, for the voice assistant and the Approve button alike.

- deliver(): the one send path. If the approved option is an email to an address listed in the
  portal's supplier profiles, send it from the agent mailbox and return the message id. Anything
  else (internal roles, no draft) is only recorded, never sent.
- POST /api/cards/{id}/tool: the voice assistant's tools. They call the inbox's own approve /
  escalate / dismiss, so a spoken "yes" and a click behave the same and land in the same
  actions.json and decision_status.json.
"""

import os
import re
import smtplib
import ssl
from email.message import EmailMessage
from email.utils import formatdate, make_msgid

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

from ask_soony.config import load_dotenv

router = APIRouter()

TOOLS = [
    {
        "type": "function",
        "name": "get_card_details",
        "description": "Look up this card's options (with recipient and draft), evidence and "
        "status. Use it before answering questions about sources, costs or what would be sent.",
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {}},
    },
    {
        "type": "function",
        "name": "decide",
        "description": "Record the person's decision on this card. approve carries out the chosen "
        "option: if it is an email to a supplier, it is sent. Only approve after reading out what "
        "will happen (recipient and gist for an email) and the person clearly said yes.",
        "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "decision": {"type": "string", "enum": ["approve", "escalate", "reject"]},
                "option_index": {"type": "integer", "description": "Which option, 0 = recommended"},
                "note": {"type": "string", "description": "Short reason or condition, if any"},
                "confirmed": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "description": "True only if the person explicitly confirmed",
                },
            },
            "required": ["decision", "confirmed"],
        },
    },
]


def supplier_addresses() -> set[str]:
    """Every email address in the portal's supplier profiles (CSV or JSON, any layout)."""
    from ask_soony import api

    root = api.portal_root()
    found: set[str] = set()
    if root is None:
        return found
    for path in (root / "suppliers").glob("*/profile.*"):
        try:
            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        except OSError:
            continue
        found |= {m.lower() for m in re.findall(r"[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+(?:\.[\w-]+)+", text)}
    return found


def _send_mail(to: str, subject: str, body: str) -> str:
    load_dotenv()
    user = os.environ.get("ASK_MAIL_ADDRESS", "")
    password = os.environ.get("ASK_MAIL_PASSWORD", "").replace(" ", "")
    host = os.environ.get("ASK_SMTP_HOST", "")
    if not (user and password and host):
        raise HTTPException(503, "mail account not configured")
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"], msg["To"], msg["Subject"] = user, to, subject
    msg["Date"] = formatdate(localtime=True)
    msg["Message-ID"] = mid = make_msgid(domain=user.split("@")[-1])
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(host, 587, timeout=30) as s:
        s.starttls(context=ssl.create_default_context())
        s.login(user, password)
        s.send_message(msg)
    return mid


def deliver(card: dict, option: dict, text: str | None) -> dict | None:
    """Send the approved option if it is an email to a known supplier; None if nothing was sent."""
    to = (option.get("to") or "").strip().lower()
    body = (text or option.get("draft") or "").strip()
    if option.get("channel") != "email" or not body or to not in supplier_addresses():
        return None
    subject = option.get("subject") or card.get("headline") or "Soony procurement"
    mid = _send_mail(to, subject, body)
    return {"message_id": mid, "to": to, "subject": subject, "sent_body": body}


class ToolCall(BaseModel):
    name: str
    arguments: dict = {}


def _details(card: dict) -> dict:
    ui = card.get("ui") or {}
    return {
        "headline": card.get("headline"),
        "summary": card.get("summary"),
        "status": card.get("status"),
        "approver": card.get("approver"),
        "options": [
            {
                "index": o.get("index", i),
                "action": o.get("action"),
                "cost": o.get("cost"),
                "effect": o.get("effect"),
                "channel": o.get("channel"),
                "to": o.get("to"),
                "draft": (o.get("draft") or "")[:600],
            }
            for i, o in enumerate(card.get("options") or [])
        ],
        "evidence": (card.get("evidence") or [])[:8],
        "supplier_reply": ui.get("reply"),
    }


@router.post("/api/cards/{card_id}/tool")
def run_tool(card_id: str, call: ToolCall):
    from ask_soony import api

    card = api._card(card_id)
    args = call.arguments or {}
    if call.name == "get_card_details":
        return _details(card)
    if call.name != "decide":
        raise HTTPException(400, f"unknown tool {call.name}")

    decision = str(args.get("decision") or "")
    note = str(args.get("note") or "").strip()[:300]
    if card.get("status") not in ("open", None):
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"Already {card.get('status')}; nothing changed."}
    if decision == "approve":
        if not args.get("confirmed"):
            return {"ok": False, "error": "Not done: ask the person to confirm first."}
        idx = int(args.get("option_index") or 0)
        if not 0 <= idx < len(card.get("options") or []):
            return {"ok": False, "error": f"No option {idx}."}
        out = api.approve(card_id, {"option": idx, "via": "voice"})
        action = out["action"]
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "status": action.get("status"),
            "sent_to": action.get("to") if action.get("status") == "sent" else None,
            "offer_trust": out.get("offer_trust"),
        }
    if decision == "escalate":
        action = api.escalate(card_id, {"note": note or "escalated by voice"})
        try:
            from ask_soony import push

            push.send("⬆️ Escalated launch alert", f"{card.get('headline', '')}", card_id)
        except Exception:  # no devices: the escalation is recorded anyway
            pass
        return {"ok": True, "status": "escalated", "to": action.get("to")}
    if decision == "reject":
        api.dismiss(card_id, {"note": note or "rejected by voice"})
        return {"ok": True, "status": "dismissed"}
    return {"ok": False, "error": f"unknown decision {decision}"}
"""
Voice conversation about a decision card, in the browser (OpenAI gpt-realtime over WebRTC).

The browser asks this route for a short-lived OpenAI client secret; the API key never leaves the
server. The secret carries the session: the card as instructions, a voice, noise handling and the
card tools (cardtools.TOOLS). The browser talks to OpenAI directly and relays tool calls to
/api/cards/{id}/tool, which decides through the inbox's own approve / escalate / dismiss.
"""

import json
import os

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException

from ask_soony import cardtools
from ask_soony.config import load_dotenv

router = APIRouter()


def _text(value) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return "; ".join(f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in value.items() if v not in (None, "", []))
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)


def instructions(card: dict) -> str:
    options = (
        "\n".join(
            f"- option {o.get('index', i)}: {o.get('action')}"
            + (f" (cost: {o['cost']})" if o.get("cost") else "")
            + (f" (effect: {o['effect']})" if o.get("effect") else "")
            + (
                f" [sends an email to {o['to']}]"
                if o.get("channel") == "email" and o.get("to")
                else ""
            )
            for i, o in enumerate(card.get("options") or [])
        )
        or "- none listed"
    )
    evidence = "\n".join(
        f"- {e.get('source') or ''}: "
        + str(e.get("value") or e.get("translation") or e.get("quote") or "")
        for e in (card.get("evidence") or [])[:6]
    )
    facts = [
        f"Headline: {card.get('headline', '')}",
        f"Summary: {card.get('summary') or ''}",
        f"Supplier: {card.get('supplier_name') or 'n/a'}, part: {card.get('part') or 'n/a'}",
        f"{card.get('number_label') or 'At risk'}: {card.get('number')}",
        f"Decide by: {card.get('deadline') or 'not given'}",
        f"Runs dry: {card.get('runs_dry') or 'n/a'}",
        f"Status: {card.get('status')}; approver: {card.get('approver') or 'the buyer'}",
        f"Evidence:\n{evidence or '- none'}",
        f"Options:\n{options}",
        f"Supplier reply so far: {(card.get('ui') or {}).get('reply') or 'none yet'}",
    ]
    return (
        "You are the procurement assistant of the dashboard, talking to a buyer about one decision "
        "card that threatens the product launch. Speak English, calmly and briefly.\n\n"
        + "\n".join(facts)
        + "\n\nStart by stating the problem in two short sentences and the recommended option. "
        "Answer questions only with the facts above; if you do not know, say so. Then ask for a "
        "decision: approve the recommended action, escalate to the next person, or reject. "
        "Tools: use get_card_details when asked about sources, costs or what would be sent. "
        "Before approving, say what will happen; for an option that sends an email, read out the "
        "recipient and gist and ask 'Shall I send it now?'. Only after a clear yes call decide "
        "with decision approve, the option index and confirmed true, then confirm in one "
        "sentence (say it was sent if sent_to is set) and say goodbye. For escalate or reject, "
        "call decide the same way.\n\n"
        "The person may be in a noisy room. Only respond to what they say to you about this card. "
        "Ignore background conversations, other languages and fragments; if unsure, ask: 'Sorry, "
        "was that for me?' Never record a decision from background speech."
    )


@router.post("/api/cards/{card_id}/voice")
def voice_session(card_id: str):
    load_dotenv()
    key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    if not key:
        raise HTTPException(503, "OPENAI_API_KEY is not set")
    from ask_soony import api  # late import: api includes this router

    card = api._card(card_id)
    model = os.environ.get("OPENAI_REALTIME_MODEL", "gpt-realtime-2.1")
    session = {
        "type": "realtime",
        "model": model,
        "instructions": instructions(card),
        "audio": {
            "output": {"voice": os.environ.get("OPENAI_REALTIME_VOICE", "marin")},
            "input": {
                "noise_reduction": {"type": "near_field"},
                "transcription": {
                    "model": "gpt-4o-mini-transcribe",
                    "language": "en",
                    "prompt": "A buyer talking about a supply chain decision card.",
                },
                "turn_detection": {
                    "type": "server_vad",
                    "threshold": float(os.environ.get("OPENAI_VAD_THRESHOLD", "0.8")),
                    "prefix_padding_ms": 300,
                    "silence_duration_ms": 700,
                    "create_response": True,
                    "interrupt_response": False,
                },
            },
        },
        "tools": cardtools.TOOLS,
        "tool_choice": "auto",
    }
    resp = httpx.post(
        "https://api.openai.com/v1/realtime/client_secrets",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"},
        json={"expires_after": {"anchor": "created_at", "seconds": 600}, "session": session},
        timeout=20,
    )
    if resp.status_code >= 300:
        raise HTTPException(502, f"OpenAI refused the session: {resp.text[:300]}")
    return {"client_secret": resp.json().get("value"), "model": model}

"""Shared fixtures for the alert agent tests."""

import json

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from test_launch import make_portal

SUPPLIER = "[REDACTED_EMAIL]"


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _no_real_dotenv(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Run every test in an empty folder, so code that calls load_dotenv() cannot pull the real
    .env (passwords, API keys) into the test process and change later tests."""
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)


@pytest.fixture
def agent_env(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    portal = make_portal(tmp_path / "portal", "400")
    profile = portal / "suppliers" / "SUP-9_Acme"
    profile.mkdir(parents=True)
    (profile / "profile.csv").write_text(
        "supplier_id,name,country,lat,lon,contact_email\n"
        f"SUP-9,Acme Paper,PL,52.4,16.9,{SUPPLIER}\n"
    )
    state, store = tmp_path / "state", tmp_path / "store"
    state.mkdir()
    store.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.setenv("ASK_PORTAL_DIR", str(portal))
    monkeypatch.setenv("ASK_STATE_DIR", str(state))
    monkeypatch.setenv("ASK_CARDS_FILE", str(store / "decision_cards.json"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("ASK_NOW", "2030-06-01T21:00:00+02:00")
    (store / "decision_cards.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "cards": [
                    {
                        "id": "gap-X",
                        "title": "300 copies short",
                        "edition": "P-A",
                        "at_risk": 300,
                        "part": "Book",
                        "options": ["Ask supplier for an earlier truck", "Ask the DC lead"],
                        "decision": "Chase the supplier?",
                        "act_by": "Sat 01 Jun 23:00",
                        "messages": [
                            {
                                "to_role": "Supplier",
                                "to_email": SUPPLIER,
                                "subject": "s",
                                "body": "Earlier truck?",
                            },
                            {
                                "to_role": "DC site lead",
                                "to_email": None,
                                "subject": "t",
                                "body": "Collect it",
                            },
                        ],
                    }
                ]
            }
        )
    )
    sent: list[tuple] = []
    from ask_soony import api, cardtools

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        cardtools,
        "_send_mail",
        lambda to, subject, body: sent.append((to, subject, body)) or "<m1@x>",
    )
    return {"state": state, "client": TestClient(api.app), "sent": sent}
"""Alert agent on the inbox API: one send path for Approve and voice, replies tied back to cards."""

import json
from email.message import EmailMessage

from conftest import SUPPLIER


def _status(agent_env) -> dict:
    return json.loads((agent_env["state"] / "decision_status.json").read_text())["gap-X"]


def test_approve_sends_the_supplier_email(agent_env):
    r = agent_env["client"].post("/api/cards/gap-X/approve", json={"option": 0})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert agent_env["sent"] == [(SUPPLIER, "300 copies short", "Earlier truck?")]
    actions = json.loads((agent_env["state"] / "actions.json").read_text())
    assert isinstance(actions, list) and actions[-1]["message_id"] == "<m1@x>"
    assert _status(agent_env)["status"] == "sent"


def test_approve_without_a_supplier_address_only_records(agent_env):
    agent_env["client"].post("/api/cards/gap-X/approve", json={"option": 1})
    assert agent_env["sent"] == []
    assert _status(agent_env)["status"] == "approved"


def test_voice_approves_only_after_a_yes_and_like_the_button(agent_env):
    tool = "/api/cards/gap-X/tool"
    no = agent_env["client"].post(
        tool, json={"name": "decide", "arguments": {"decision": "approve"}}
    )
    assert no.json()["ok"] is False and agent_env["sent"] == []
    yes = agent_env["client"].post(
        tool, json={"name": "decide", "arguments": {"decision": "approve", "confirmed": True}}
    )
    out = yes.json()
    assert (out["ok"], out["status"], out["sent_to"]) == (True, "sent", SUPPLIER)
    assert len(agent_env["sent"]) == 1
    again = agent_env["client"].post(
        tool, json={"name": "decide", "arguments": {"decision": "approve", "confirmed": True}}
    )
    assert again.json()["ok"] is False and len(agent_env["sent"]) == 1


def test_reply_is_attached_to_the_card(agent_env, monkeypatch):
    from ask_soony import replies

    agent_env["client"].post("/api/cards/gap-X/approve", json={"option": 0})
    reply = EmailMessage()
    reply["From"], reply["Subject"] = f"Ann <{SUPPLIER}>", "Re: 300 copies short"
    reply["Message-ID"], reply["In-Reply-To"] = "<[REDACTED_EMAIL]>", "<m1@x>"
    reply.set_content("Yes, 300 on Sunday's 06:00 truck.\n\n> Earlier truck?")

    class FakeImap:
        def __init__(self, *a, **k): ...
        def login(self, *a): ...
        def select(self, *a, **k): ...
        def search(self, *a):
            return "OK", [b"1"]

"""
Evidence anchoring: find where a card's numbers and ids actually appear in the portal documents,
down to the PDF page, the scanned word or the spreadsheet row, so the UI can open the file there
and highlight it.

Every portal file is indexed once (cached by content hash under <ASK_DATA_DIR>/anchors/):
- PDF pages with a text layer: words with their boxes (pypdfium2)
- scanned PDF pages and images: words with boxes from local OCR (tesseract; Latin models are
  enough because numbers and ids are written in Latin script in every supplier language)
- CSV / XLSX: one unit per row; JSON, Markdown, text and mail: one unit per line

A card's evidence is turned into search tokens (numbers with thousands separators removed, ids
like PO, shipment or part numbers) and matched against the index; units sharing the most tokens,
boosted by the card's part, shipment and supplier, become anchors. Nothing about Soony is
hardcoded: it works on whatever files the portal holds.
"""

import csv
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import threading
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import Response

router = APIRouter()
_lock = threading.Lock()
_index: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}  # doc path -> units
_state = {"building": False, "done": False, "files": 0}

TEXT_SUFFIXES = {".json", ".md", ".txt", ".eml", ".html", ".xml"}
IMAGE_SUFFIXES = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp", ".tif", ".tiff"}
_THOUSANDS = re.compile(r"(?<=\d)[,.'   ](?=\d{3}(?!\d))")
_TOKEN = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:[-_/][A-Za-z0-9]+)*")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- tokens


def norm(text: str) -> str:
    """Upper-case with thousands separators removed: '56.000' and '56,000' both become '56000'."""
    prev = None
    s = str(text)
    while prev != s:  # 1,234,567 needs more than one pass
        prev, s = s, _THOUSANDS.sub("", s)
    return s.upper()


def tokens(text: str) -> set[str]:
    return set(_TOKEN.findall(norm(text)))


def search_tokens(text: str) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Tokens worth searching for, with a weight: ids 3, long numbers 2, short numbers 1."""

input.content:
"""
Demo cards from the real portal data: writes findings, decisions and impacts into data/state.

Every quantity, date, price and address on a card is read from the portal files at run time
(SAP exports, stock snapshot, pack-out log, supplier profiles). Only the document references live
in this script: which goods receipt or PO a case is about, which file and page shows the other
side, and the verbatim text that proves it. A case whose files or rows are missing, or whose
document no longer says what the script expects, is skipped with a warning.

Entries are merged by id (other entries stay), so running it twice changes nothing but the
timestamps. Nothing is approved and no email is sent.

    uv run python scripts/demo_cards.py            # add or refresh the demo cards
    uv run python scripts/demo_cards.py --reset    # also clear decisions, actions, replies,
                                                   # Teams posts and drafts; switch routines off

--reset first backs up every file it changes as <name>.before-demo-<timestamp>.json.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import shutil
import sys
from datetime import datetime, time, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))
from ask_soony import api  # noqa: E402

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- document references (data)

ART_BOOKS = {
    "gr": "5000413065",
    "scan": "soony/receiving/DC-HAM/20261118_WZ-261116-473.jpg",
    "scan_quote": "WZ-261116-473 · 80.000 struck through, 8 000 written by hand · 40 packages, 360 kg",
    "scan_translation": "Delivery note: the printed 80,000 is crossed out and corrected by hand "
    "to 8,000 (40 packages, 360 kg).",
    "offer": "suppliers/SUP-0028_Karton_Nowak/notices/Oferta_tryb_ekspresowy_2026-11-21.pdf",
    "offer_checks": ["8,000 pcs", "overrun from", "loaded"],
    "offer_quote": "CMP-GAM-008 Art Book Grand Heist 6 (96 p, hardcover) · 8 000 szt. / 8,000 pcs "
    "· overrun from production, in our finished-goods store · loaded within 4 h of your order",
    "offer_qty": 8000,
    "supplier_dir": "suppliers/SUP-0028_Karton_Nowak",
    "decide_by": time(10, 0),
    "lead_h": 1,
}

SLEEVES = {
    "ecn": "ECN-2026-118",
    "pos": ["4500318752", "4500318765", "4500318774", "4500318786"],
    "supplier_dir": "suppliers/SUP-0029_Guangzhou_PackRight",
    "supplier_part": "PR-SL-0604",
    "old_quote": "Artwork PR-SL-0604: rev. B (GH6_sleeve_revB.pdf)",
    # Karton Nowak already prints to the released file; its confirmations name it.
    "new_file_doc": "suppliers/SUP-0028_Karton_Nowak/order_confirmations/OA26293887_4500318775.pdf",
    "new_file": "GH6_sleeve_revC_USK2026.pdf",
    "decide_by": time(12, 0),
    "lead_h": 3,
}

STATUES = {
    "gr": "5000413063",
    "report": "soony/receiving/DC-HAM/inspection_report_5000413063.pdf",
    "report_checks": ["Lot does not meet AQL", "unrestricted", "concession"],
    "report_quote": "Goods receipt 5000413063 · 5,600 · 9 of 125 statues with paint defects. "
    "Lot does not meet AQL. Booked to stock as 'unrestricted' by receiving because the supplier "
    "is listed as active.",
    "decide_by": time(10, 0),
    "lead_h": 1,
}

DEMO_IDS_PREFIXES = ("gr-", "rev-", "qa-")
RESET_FILES = {
    "decision_status.json": {},
    "actions.json": [],
    "replies_seen.json": [],
    "teams_posted.json": [],
    "routine_drafts.json": {},
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- portal helpers


def warn(msg: str) -> None:
    print(f"warning: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)


def n(v) -> int:
    return int(api.num(v) or 0)


def fmt(v: float) -> str:
    return f"{v:,.0f}"


def fmt_date(value: str) -> str:
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(value).strftime("%a %-d %b")
    except ValueError:
        return value


def csvs(root: Path, folder: str, pattern: str) -> list[dict]:
    rows: list[dict] = []
    for f in sorted((root / folder).glob(pattern)):
        rows += [{**r, "_file": str(f.relative_to(root))} for r in api.read_csv(f)]
    return rows


def pdf_text(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        import pypdfium2 as pdfium

        doc = pdfium.PdfDocument(str(path))
        text = " ".join(page.get_textpage().get_text_range() for page in doc)
    except Exception:  # unreadable or not a PDF
        return ""
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)


def says(root: Path, rel: str, checks: list[str]) -> bool:
    """The document exists and (for a PDF with a text layer) contains every check string."""
    path = root / rel
    if not path.is_file():
        warn(f"{rel} is missing")
        return False
    if path.suffix.lower() != ".pdf":
        return True
    text = pdf_text(path)
    missing = [c for c in checks if re.sub(r"\s+", " ", c) not in text]
    if missing:
        warn(f"{rel} no longer says {missing}")
    return not missing


def contact(root: Path, supplier_dir: str) -> dict:
    rows = api.read_csv(root / supplier_dir / "profile.csv")
    return rows[0] if rows else {}


def stock(root: Path) -> tuple[list[dict], str]:
    rows = csvs(root, "soony/erp", "stock_snapshot*.csv")
    return rows, max((r.get("snapshot_date") or "" for r in rows), default="")


def to_pack(root: Path, part: str, snapshot: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """Edition that needs this part and the copies still to pack as of the stock snapshot."""
    bom = [r for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "bom.csv") if r.get("child_id") == part]
    launch = {
        r["product_id"]: r
        for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "products.csv")
        if r.get("lifecycle") == "launch"
    }
    for b in bom:
        p = launch.get(b.get("parent_id") or "")
        if not p:
            continue
        packed = sum(
            n(r.get("units_packed"))
            for r in csvs(root, "soony/erp", "packout_log*.csv")
            if r.get("product_id") == p["product_id"] and (r.get("date") or "") <= snapshot
        )
        return p["product_id"], (n(p.get("day_one_qty")) - packed) * n(b.get("qty_per") or 1)
    return "", 0


def launch_day(root: Path) -> datetime:
    dates = [
        r["launch_date"]
        for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "products.csv")
        if r.get("lifecycle") == "launch" and r.get("launch_date")
    ]
    day = datetime.fromisoformat(min(dates)) if dates else api.now()
    return day.replace(tzinfo=api.tz())


def deadline(root: Path, at: time, lead_h: float, cur: datetime) -> str:
    """The case's decide-by time on launch day, but never less than lead_h from now."""
    fixed = datetime.combine(launch_day(root).date(), at, tzinfo=api.tz())
    soon = cur + timedelta(hours=lead_h)
    soon = soon.replace(minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0) + timedelta(hours=1)
    return max(fixed, soon).isoformat()


def trail(cur: datetime, steps: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[dict]:
    start = cur - timedelta(minutes=2 * len(steps))
    return [
        {"agent": a, "at": (start + timedelta(minutes=2 * i)).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
         "text": t}
        for i, (a, t) in enumerate(steps)
    ]


def po_line(po: dict) -> str:
    return (
        f"PO {po['po_number']} line {po['po_line']} · {po['material_id']} · {po['quantity']} pcs "
        f"· promised {po['promised_date']} · {po['status']}"
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- cases


Card = tuple[dict, dict, dict]


def art_books(root: Path, cur: datetime) -> list[Card]:
    c = ART_BOOKS
    gr = next((r for r in csvs(root, "soony/erp", "goods_receipts*.csv")
               if r.get("gr_number") == c["gr"]), None)
    if gr is None:
        warn(f"goods receipt {c['gr']} not found")
        return []
    if not (says(root, c["scan"], []) and says(root, c["offer"], c["offer_checks"])):
        return []
    part, po_no, ordered, booked = (
        gr["material_id"], gr["po_number"], n(gr["qty_ordered"]), n(gr["qty_received"]),
    )
    rows, snapshot = stock(root)
    system = sum(n(r.get("quantity")) for r in rows if r.get("material_id") == part)
    real = system - booked + ordered
    edition, need = to_pack(root, part, snapshot)
    short = max(0, need - real)
    po = next((r for r in csvs(root, "soony/erp", "purchase_orders*.csv")
               if r.get("po_number") == po_no and r.get("po_line") == gr.get("po_line")), {})
    price, currency = api.num(po.get("unit_price")) or 0, po.get("currency") or "EUR"
    who = contact(root, c["supplier_dir"])
    offer_name = Path(c["offer"]).name
    fid = f"gr-{c['gr']}-{part}"
    finding = {
        "id": fid, "kind": "mismatch", "part": part, "supplier": gr.get("supplier_id"),
        "title": f"SAP counts {fmt(system)} art books; the shelf holds {fmt(real)}",
        "summary": (
            f"Goods receipt {c['gr']} booked {fmt(booked)} for PO {po_no} line {gr['po_line']} "
            f"(ordered {fmt(ordered)}, remark '{gr.get('remark')}'). The delivery note "
            f"{gr.get('delivery_note')} was corrected by hand to {fmt(ordered)}."
        ),
        "status": "open", "level": "red", "created_at": cur.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "sides": [
            {
                "source": "System says · SAP goods receipt",
                "value": f"{fmt(booked)} received on GR {c['gr']} (ordered {fmt(ordered)})",
                "doc": gr["_file"],
                "quote": (
                    f"GR {c['gr']} · PO {po_no} line {gr['po_line']} · {part} · ordered {ordered}"
                    f" · received {booked} · {gr.get('remark')}"
                ),
            },
            {
                "source": "System says · SAP stock",
                "value": f"{fmt(system)} art books in stock on {snapshot}",
                "doc": next((r["_file"] for r in rows if r.get("material_id") == part), None),
                "quote": f"{part} · batch {c['gr']} · {booked} PC",
            },
            {
                "source": f"Paper says · delivery note {gr.get('delivery_note')} (PL)",
                "value": f"{fmt(ordered)} delivered, not {fmt(booked)}",
                "doc": c["scan"], "page": 1, "language": "pl",
                "quote": c["scan_quote"], "translation": c["scan_translation"],
            },
            {
                "source": "Supplier offer · Karton Nowak rush service (PL/EN)",
                "value": f"{fmt(c['offer_qty'])} art books in stock, loaded within 4 h",
                "doc": c["offer"], "page": 1, "language": "pl", "quote": c["offer_quote"],
            },
        ],
        "trail": trail(cur, [
            ("Watcher", f"Read the delivery note scan {Path(c['scan']).name} from DC Hamburg."),
            ("Verification", f"Matched GR {c['gr']} in SAP: {fmt(booked)} booked against "
                             f"{fmt(ordered)} ordered; the scan shows {fmt(ordered)}."),
            ("Impact", f"{fmt(real)} art books for {fmt(need)} Collector's copies still to pack: "
                       f"{fmt(short)} short."),
        ]),
    }
    decision = {
        "finding_id": fid, "level": "red",
        "headline": f"We have {fmt(real)} art books, not {fmt(system)}. The Collector's cell runs "
        f"out about {fmt(short)} copies early.",
        "reason": "Karton Nowak has art books in stock and can load a truck within hours; the "
        "goods receipt should be corrected too, so SAP stops hiding the gap.",
        "deadline": deadline(root, c["decide_by"], c["lead_h"], cur),
        "options": [
            {
                "action": f"Order Karton Nowak's {fmt(c['offer_qty'])} art books from stock "
                "(truck tonight)",
                "cost": f"about {currency} {fmt(c['offer_qty'] * price)}",
                "effect": f"covers the {fmt(short)} gap; Poznań to Hamburg is about 9 h by truck",
                "channel": "email", "to": who.get("contact_email"), "recommended": True,
                "draft": (
                    f"Dear {who.get('contact_name') or 'Karton Nowak team'},\n\n"
                    f"thank you for your rush offer ({offer_name}). We would like to order the "
                    f"{fmt(c['offer_qty'])} Art Books Grand Heist 6 ({part}) from your "
                    "finished-goods store at the Annex A price, delivered to DC Hamburg.\n\n"
                    "Please load them on the next truck and send us the truck details and the "
                    "delivery note number.\n\n"
                    "Best regards,\nSoony Procurement"
                ),
            },
            {
                "action": f"Ask receiving to correct the goods receipt to {fmt(ordered)}",
                "cost": "No cost", "effect": "SAP shows the real stock again",
                "channel": "notify", "to": "DC receiving",
                "draft": (
                    f"Please correct goods receipt {c['gr']} (PO {po_no} line {gr['po_line']}) "
                    f"from {fmt(booked)} to {fmt(ordered)}: delivery note "
                    f"{gr.get('delivery_note')} was corrected by hand to {fmt(ordered)}."
                ),
            },
        ],
    }
    impact = {"finding_id": fid, "copies_at_risk": short, "edition": edition,
              "deadline": decision["deadline"]}
    return [(finding, decision, impact)]


def sleeves(root: Path, cur: datetime) -> list[Card]:
    c = SLEEVES
    ecn = next((r for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "bom_delta*.csv")
                if r.get("change_id") == c["ecn"]), None)
    if ecn is None:
        warn(f"{c['ecn']} not found")
        return []
    if not says(root, c["new_file_doc"], [c["new_file"]]):
        return []
    part, old, new = ecn["child_id"], ecn.get("rev_old"), ecn.get("rev_new")
    who = contact(root, c["supplier_dir"])
    pos = csvs(root, "soony/erp", "purchase_orders*.csv")
    out: list[Card] = []
    for po_no in c["pos"]:
        lines = [r for r in pos if r.get("po_number") == po_no and r.get("material_id") == part
                 and r.get("status") == "open"]
        oa = sorted((root / c["supplier_dir"] / "order_confirmations").glob(f"OA*_{po_no}.pdf"))
        if not lines or not oa:
            warn(f"PO {po_no}: no open {part} line or no order confirmation")
            continue
        oa_rel = str(oa[0].relative_to(root))
        if not says(root, oa_rel, [c["old_quote"]]):
            continue
        qty = sum(n(r["quantity"]) for r in lines)
        due = " / ".join(fmt_date(r["promised_date"]) for r in lines)
        oa_no = oa[0].name.split("_")[0]
        fid = f"rev-{po_no}-{part}"
        finding = {
            "id": fid, "kind": "revision", "part": part, "supplier": lines[0].get("supplier_id"),
            "title": f"PackRight confirmed PO {po_no} with the old sleeve artwork (rev {old})",
            "summary": (
                f"{c['ecn']} moved {part} from rev {old} to rev {new} ({ecn.get('reason')}). "
                f"PackRight's confirmation {oa_no} still prints {fmt(qty)} sleeves to rev {old}."
            ),
            "status": "open", "level": "amber", "created_at": cur.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            "sides": [
                {
                    "source": "System says · SAP purchase order",
                    "value": f"{fmt(qty)} sleeves due {due}, open",
                    "doc": lines[0]["_file"],
                    "quote": " ; ".join(po_line(r) for r in lines),
                },
                {
                    "source": f"Paper says · PackRight order confirmation {oa_no} (EN)",
                    "value": f"artwork rev. {old}",
                    "doc": oa_rel, "page": 1, "language": "en",
                    "quote": f"PO {po_no} · {c['supplier_part']} · {fmt(qty)} · {c['old_quote']}",
                },
                {
                    "source": f"Engineering change {c['ecn']}",

                if r.get("material_id") == part and r.get("batch") == c["gr"])

    edition, need = to_pack(root, part, snapshot)

                "100% sort today",

                "channel": "notify", "to": "Supplier Quality, Category lead", "recommended": True,
                "draft": (
                    f"Goods receipt {c['gr']} (PO {gr['po_number']}, {fmt(lot)} statues {part}) "
                    "failed incoming inspection but is booked unrestricted. Without it we are "
                    f"{fmt(short)} Collector's copies short. Please decide today: a concession "
                    "or a 100% sort at DC Hamburg."
                ),
            },
        ],
    }
    impact = {"finding_id": fid, "copies_at_risk": short, "edition": edition,
              "deadline": decision["deadline"]}
    return [(finding, decision, impact)]


CASES = (art_books, sleeves, statues)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- writing


def merge(name: str, key: str, entries: list[dict]) -> None:
    new = {e[key]: e for e in entries}
    kept = [e for e in api.read_list(name) if e.get(key) not in new]
    api.write_json(name, kept + list(new.values()))


def backup(name: str, stamp: str) -> None:
    path = api.state_dir() / name
    if path.exists():
        shutil.copy2(path, path.with_name(f"{path.stem}.before-demo-{stamp}.json"))


def reset(stamp: str) -> None:
    for name, empty in RESET_FILES.items():
        backup(name, stamp)
        api.write_json(name, empty)
    backup("routines.json", stamp)
    routines = api.read_list("routines.json")
    for r in routines:
        r["enabled"] = False
    api.write_json("routines.json", routines)


def build(root: Path, cur: datetime) -> list[Card]:
    cards: list[Card] = []
    for case in CASES:
        try:
            cards += case(root, cur)
        except (KeyError, ValueError) as exc:  # a file changed shape: skip this case only
            warn(f"{case.__name__} skipped: {exc!r}")
    return cards


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0] if __doc__ else None)
    ap.add_argument("--reset", action="store_true", help="clear decisions, actions and routines")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    root = api.portal_root()
    if root is None:
        print("No portal data found under data/ (set ASK_PORTAL_DIR).", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    cur = api.now()
    if args.reset:
        reset(cur.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"))
    cards = build(root, cur)
    merge("findings.json", "id", [f for f, _, _ in cards])
    merge("decisions.json", "finding_id", [d for _, d, _ in cards])
    merge("impacts.json", "finding_id", [i for _, _, i in cards])
    for f, d, _ in cards:
        print(f"{f['id']}: {d['headline']}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""
Demo cards from the real portal data: writes findings, decisions and impacts into data/state.

Every quantity, date, price and address on a card is read from the portal files at run time
(SAP exports, stock snapshot, pack-out log, supplier profiles). Only the document references live
in this script: which goods receipt or PO a case is about, which file and page shows the other
side, and the verbatim text that proves it. A case whose files or rows are missing, or whose
document no longer says what the script expects, is skipped with a warning.

Entries are merged by id (other entries stay), so running it twice changes nothing but the
timestamps. Nothing is approved and no email is sent.

    uv run python scripts/demo_cards.py            # add or refresh the demo cards
    uv run python scripts/demo_cards.py --reset    # also clear decisions, actions, replies,
                                                   # Teams posts and drafts; switch routines off

--reset first backs up every file it changes as <name>.before-demo-<timestamp>.json.
"""

from pathlib import Path

from ask_soony import api  # noqa: E402

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- portal helpers


def warn(msg: str) -> None:
    print(f"warning: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)


def n(v) -> int:
    return int(api.num(v) or 0)


def fmt(v: float) -> str:
    return f"{v:,.0f}"


def fmt_date(value: str) -> str:
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(value).strftime("%a %-d %b")
    except ValueError:
        return value


def csvs(root: Path, folder: str, pattern: str) -> list[dict]:
    rows: list[dict] = []
    for f in sorted((root / folder).glob(pattern)):
        rows += [{**r, "_file": str(f.relative_to(root))} for r in api.read_csv(f)]
    return rows


def pdf_text(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        import pypdfium2 as pdfium

        doc = pdfium.PdfDocument(str(path))
        text = " ".join(page.get_textpage().get_text_range() for page in doc)
    except Exception:  # unreadable or not a PDF
        return ""
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)


def says(root: Path, rel: str, checks: list[str]) -> bool:
    """The document exists and (for a PDF with a text layer) contains every check string."""
    path = root / rel
    if not path.is_file():
        warn(f"{rel} is missing")
        return False
    if path.suffix.lower() != ".pdf":
        return True
    text = pdf_text(path)
    missing = [c for c in checks if re.sub(r"\s+", " ", c) not in text]
    if missing:
        warn(f"{rel} no longer says {missing}")
    return not missing


def contact(root: Path, supplier_dir: str) -> dict:
    rows = api.read_csv(root / supplier_dir / "profile.csv")
    return rows[0] if rows else {}


def stock(root: Path) -> tuple[list[dict], str]:
    rows = csvs(root, "soony/erp", "stock_snapshot*.csv")
    return rows, max((r.get("snapshot_date") or "" for r in rows), default="")


def to_pack(root: Path, part: str, snapshot: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """Edition that needs this part and the copies still to pack as of the stock snapshot."""
    bom = [r for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "bom.csv") if r.get("child_id") == part]
    launch = {
        r["product_id"]: r
        for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "products.csv")
        if r.get("lifecycle") == "launch"
    }
    for b in bom:
        p = launch.get(b.get("parent_id") or "")
        if not p:
            continue
        packed = sum(
            n(r.get("units_packed"))
            for r in csvs(root, "soony/erp", "packout_log*.csv")
            if r.get("product_id") == p["product_id"] and (r.get("date") or "") <= snapshot
        )
        return p["product_id"], (n(p.get("day_one_qty")) - packed) * n(b.get("qty_per") or 1)
    return "", 0


def launch_day(root: Path) -> datetime:
    dates = [
        r["launch_date"]
        for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "products.csv")
        if r.get("lifecycle") == "launch" and r.get("launch_date")
    ]
    day = datetime.fromisoformat(min(dates)) if dates else api.now()
    return day.replace(tzinfo=api.tz())


def deadline(root: Path, at: time, lead_h: float, cur: datetime) -> str:
    """The case's decide-by time on launch day, but never less than lead_h from now."""
    fixed = datetime.combine(launch_day(root).date(), at, tzinfo=api.tz())
    soon = cur + timedelta(hours=lead_h)
    soon = soon.replace(minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0) + timedelta(hours=1)
    return max(fixed, soon).isoformat()


def trail(cur: datetime, steps: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[dict]:
    start = cur - timedelta(minutes=2 * len(steps))
    return [
        {"agent": a, "at": (start + timedelta(minutes=2 * i)).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
         "text": t}
        for i, (a, t) in enumerate(steps)
    ]

        f"· promised {po['promised_date']} · {po['status']}"

def art_books(root: Path, cur: datetime) -> list[Card]:

                    "quote": f"{c['ecn']} · {part} · rev {old} to {new} · {ecn.get('reason')}",
                },
            ],
            "trail": trail(cur, [
                ("Watcher", f"Read {Path(ecn['_file']).name}: {part} moves to rev {new}."),
                ("Verification", f"Checked PackRight's confirmation {oa_no} for PO {po_no}: "
                                 f"artwork rev. {old}."),

                                 "still open."),

        }
        decision = {
            "finding_id": fid, "level": "amber",
            "headline": f"PackRight confirmed PO {po_no} with the old sleeve artwork (rev {old})",
            "reason": f"Sleeves printed to rev {old} cannot be packed. It is still free to fix "
            "before printing starts.",

            "options": [

                        "send us a corrected order confirmation. If you do not have the file, "
                        "reply and we will send it today.\n\n"
                        "Best regards,\nSoony Procurement"
                    ),
                },
                {
                    "action": "Tell the category lead", "cost": "No cost",
                    "effect": "the category lead follows up with PackRight",
                    "channel": "notify", "to": "Category lead",
                    "draft": f"PackRight confirmed PO {po_no} ({fmt(qty)} sleeves) with artwork "
                    f"rev {old}; {c['ecn']} requires rev {new}.",

    return out


def statues(root: Path, cur: datetime) -> list[Card]:
    c = STATUES
    gr = next((r for r in csvs(root, "soony/erp", "goods_receipts*.csv")

    if gr is None:
        warn(f"goods receipt {c['gr']} not found")
        return []
    if not says(root, c["report"], c["report_checks"]):
        return []
    part, lot = gr["material_id"], n(gr["qty_received"])
    rows, snapshot = stock(root)
    total = sum(n(r.get("quantity")) for r in rows if r.get("material_id") == part)
    batch = sum(n(r.get("quantity")) for r in rows
                if r.get("material_id") == part and r.get("batch") == c["gr"])
    usable = total - batch
    edition, need = to_pack(root, part, snapshot)
    short = max(0, need - usable)
    fid = f"qa-{c['gr']}-{part}"
    finding = {
        "id": fid, "kind": "quality", "part": part, "supplier": gr.get("supplier_id"),
        "title": f"{fmt(batch)} statues in stock failed incoming inspection",
        "summary": (
            f"Goods receipt {c['gr']} (PO {gr['po_number']}) put {fmt(lot)} statues in stock as "
            "unrestricted, but the inspection report rejects the lot. Without them "
            f"{fmt(usable)} statues are usable for {fmt(need)} Collector's copies."
        ),
        "status": "open", "level": "red", "created_at": cur.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "sides": [
            {
                "source": "System says · SAP stock",
                "value": f"{fmt(batch)} statues on GR {c['gr']}, {fmt(total)} in stock",
                "doc": next((r["_file"] for r in rows if r.get("batch") == c["gr"]), None),
                "quote": f"{part} · batch {c['gr']} · {batch} PC",
            },
            {
                "source": "Paper says · incoming inspection report (EN)",
                "value": f"GR {c['gr']} · {fmt(lot)} statues rejected (AQL 1.0)",
                "doc": c["report"], "page": 1, "language": "en", "quote": c["report_quote"],
            },
        ],
        "trail": trail(cur, [
            ("Watcher", f"Read {Path(c['report']).name} from DC Hamburg."),
            ("Verification", f"Matched GR {c['gr']} in SAP: {fmt(lot)} statues booked "
                             "unrestricted; the report rejects the lot."),
            ("Impact", f"{fmt(usable)} usable statues for {fmt(need)} Collector's copies: "
                       f"{fmt(short)} short."),
        ]),
    }
    decision = {
        "finding_id": fid, "level": "red",
        "headline": f"{fmt(batch)} statues on the shelf failed inspection. Without them we are "
        f"{fmt(short)} Collector's copies short.",
        "reason": "The report allows use only under a concession signed by Supplier Quality and "
        "the category lead; a 100% sort could free the good statues today.",
        "deadline": deadline(root, c["decide_by"], c["lead_h"], cur),
        "options": [
            {
                "action": "Ask Supplier Quality and the category lead for a concession or a "
                "100% sort today",
                "cost": "No cost", "effect": "the good statues of the lot can be packed",
                "channel": "notify", "to": "Supplier Quality, Category lead", "recommended": True,
                "draft": (
                    f"Goods receipt {c['gr']} (PO {gr['po_number']}, {fmt(lot)} statues {part}) "
                    "failed incoming inspection but is booked unrestricted. Without it we are "
                    f"{fmt(short)} Collector's copies short. Please decide today: a concession "
                    "or a 100% sort at DC Hamburg."
                ),
            },
        ],
    }
    impact = {"finding_id": fid, "copies_at_risk": short, "edition": edition,
              "deadline": decision["deadline"]}
    return [(finding, decision, impact)]


CASES = (art_books, sleeves, statues)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- writing


def merge(name: str, key: str, entries: list[dict]) -> None:
    new = {e[key]: e for e in entries}
    kept = [e for e in api.read_list(name) if e.get(key) not in new]
    api.write_json(name, kept + list(new.values()))


def backup(name: str, stamp: str) -> None:
    path = api.state_dir() / name
    if path.exists():
        shutil.copy2(path, path.with_name(f"{path.stem}.before-demo-{stamp}.json"))


def reset(stamp: str) -> None:
    for name, empty in RESET_FILES.items():
        backup(name, stamp)
        api.write_json(name, empty)
    backup("routines.json", stamp)
    routines = api.read_list("routines.json")
    for r in routines:
        r["enabled"] = False
    api.write_json("routines.json", routines)


def build(root: Path, cur: datetime) -> list[Card]:
    cards: list[Card] = []
    for case in CASES:
        try:
            cards += case(root, cur)
        except (KeyError, ValueError) as exc:  # a file changed shape: skip this case only
            warn(f"{case.__name__} skipped: {exc!r}")
    return cards


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0] if __doc__ else None)
    ap.add_argument("--reset", action="store_true", help="clear decisions, actions and routines")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    root = api.portal_root()
    if root is None:
        print("No portal data found under data/ (set ASK_PORTAL_DIR).", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    cur = api.now()
    if args.reset:
        reset(cur.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"))
    cards = build(root, cur)
    merge("findings.json", "id", [f for f, _, _ in cards])
    merge("decisions.json", "finding_id", [d for _, d, _ in cards])
    merge("impacts.json", "finding_id", [i for _, _, i in cards])
    for f, d, _ in cards:
        print(f"{f['id']}: {d['headline']}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
